content.title: Request a genre that does not exist
content.intent: Prove that a missing genre returns a 404 and the page shows `No books found in this genre.`
content.technique_notes: Techniques: Negative / error (`negative`) and Pagination / sort / filter (`pagination`) via the Search / list profile. This is a separate negative path because its outcome changes from a valid listing page to an error page with a 404 response. Budget ceiling max_pairs=3 retained it as the required negative genre-browsing path.
